title: analytics: the dataset draft preview serves a dimension the dataset does not declare, which the live strategies refuse INVALID_FIELD
body:
domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czuTWNgKR22fKv7jia

Filing gate: ② an out-of-scope finding measured by the #28172 card thread on `main` @ `35f20551` (real SQLite). Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

## Measured

A dataset declaring dimension `region` and measures `total` (sum of `amount`) and `deals` (count). Selecting `{ dimensions: ['bogus'], measures: ['total'] }`:

| Face | Answer |
|:---|:---|
| native strategy | refused `INVALID_FIELD` / 400, "Valid dimensions: region" |
| ObjectQL strategy | same refusal |
| draft preview (`previewDrafts: true`) | served `[{ bogus: null, total: 180 }]` |

An undeclared dimension that names a real field of the object (`amount`) is served on all three faces alike, so only a name that is neither declared nor a field differs.

## Wanted (route is triage's)

The draft preview refuses an undeclared dimension the way the live faces do, with the same envelope, so an author does not see a plausible number under a misspelled dimension before publishing. #28172 does the same for measures (PR pending); this is the dimension half, a sibling of it on the same preview seam (`assertDimensionFields`). Expected `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`.

## Dedupe

Read the open titles for `preview`, `undeclared dimension`, `assertDimensionFields`: only #28172 (measures). **New.**

Links: #28172, #28127.
